speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me understand the root cause, could you please tell me how long you have been feeling this way and if it is worse in the morning or evening?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detail; the worsening fatigue towards the end of the day after travel and hiking is concerning. Given your recent outdoor activities and multiple illnesses, have you noticed any specific symptoms like muscle cramps, dark urine, or fever?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Weakness and fatigue. I also have Mild diplopia. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis. The combination of worsening fatigue throughout the day, recent infections, and the new onset of mild diplopia is classic for this neuromuscular junction disorder.
